name: Check appointment availability in Google Calendar

parameters.content:
## Check appointment availability in Google Calendar

Validate a requested interval, check Google Calendar and return a clear available or busy result for a voice or chat assistant.

Services: n8n and Google Calendar.

Setup:
1. Choose a Webhook Header Auth credential and set a unique path.
2. Choose a Google Calendar OAuth credential on every Google Calendar node and replace YOUR_CALENDAR_ID with the same selected calendar.
3. Use ISO timestamps with an explicit offset. Test only on a dedicated test calendar before activation.
4. Send start and end in the JSON request body. Confirm that a busy interval returns available false and provider errors never return available true.

Keep this workflow inactive until configured and tested.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'unavailable', message: 'The calendar could not be checked. No availability claim was made.' } }}
